source_snapshot.items: PCIe Retimer Upstream/Downstream Receiver Margin Test
source_snapshot.procedure: Use lspci -PP to identify AMD BDFs; select receiver=2 for retimer upstream RX or receiver=3 for downstream RX; run amdxio -margin -pcie with comma-separated BDFs, ber=10 and errcnt=5; collect output/logs.
source_snapshot.criteria: PASS when each result CSV contains one row per tested lane; example eight OAMs x16 equals 128 rows.
source_snapshot.script: No script; fifteen attended and ten machine minutes; code is unique.
source_snapshot.deepseek: NO/MANUAL physical protocol-analyzer claim, although the authoritative Procedure specifies a local amdxio software command and no analyzer attachment.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: MANUAL ONLY/CRITICAL, carrying the external-analyzer assumption while also naming amdxio; requires physical mapping and separate receiver runs.

historical_reviews.deepseek: Introduces external analyzer hardware not stated by the Master and therefore cannot by itself justify NO automation.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: Adds valuable topology, calibration-like controls and per-run evidence separation, but its MANUAL ONLY classification depends on the same unproven physical-analyzer premise.
historical_reviews.adjacent_context: The preceding baseline case is already counted. This row uniquely targets retimer upstream/downstream receivers; the next row targets XGMI receiver margining and cannot share lane/BDF evidence.
historical_reviews.v3_1: ED-01/03 require source-command fit; ED-07/08 preserve per-lane evidence; ED-17/18 protect logs/state; ED-36/38 separate review from DUT verdict.

original_test_intent: Collect PCIe retimer upstream and downstream receiver margin-search results for every approved lane using the exact BDF/receiver mapping and verify complete per-lane CSV coverage.
original_method: Resolve physical topology to BDFs, verify the supported amdxio package and receiver flag semantics, preserve baselines, execute separately bounded receiver=2 and receiver=3 software runs on approved links, retain separate raw CSVs and validate unique expected lane identities/counts without inventing signal-quality thresholds.
manual_activity: A platform/PCIe owner confirms whether amdxio alone is the intended instrument, approves BDF/retimer/lane/receiver mapping and determines whether source row-count completeness is the whole acceptance contract.
required_inputs: Exact PCIe root/retimer/OAM topology with upstream/downstream ports, BDFs, negotiated width/speed and lane IDs
Compatible amdxio version/path/checksum and documentation for margin/pcie/receiver/ber/errcnt options
Authoritative receiver=2 upstream and receiver=3 downstream mapping for the installed retimer
Expected per-run lane identity/count matrix, including absent/downtrained links
Decision whether an external analyzer/fixture is required despite not appearing in Master
Decision whether CSV row completeness alone is PASS or margin-value thresholds also apply
safety_requirements: Preserve dmesg/syslog/SEL and PCIe error/link baseline; do not clear logs
Verify every BDF and receiver flag against the topology before execution
Run upstream and downstream as separate bounded operations; do not merge or duplicate CSV rows
Stop on wrong target, link loss/downtrain, AER/error burst, tool incompatibility or unexpected mutation
Do not attach physical equipment or apply unstated margin thresholds without explicit decision; no automatic retry
agent_execution_scope: Collect read-only lspci/topology/link/error baseline and verify amdxio artifact
After approval, run exact receiver=2 and receiver=3 commands separately on the supplied BDF sets
Capture full stdout/stderr/status and raw CSVs, validate unique lane identities/counts per run
Collect post-link/error health and prepare unresolved margin values for owner review
Perform no physical reconfiguration, guessed mapping, invented threshold or independent DUT verdict
engineer_actions: Resolve software-only versus analyzer-assisted execution and approve tool/parameters
Supply exact retimer/BDF/lane/receiver matrices and expected row counts
Define any margin-value thresholds beyond source row count and issue PASS, FAIL or BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: DeepSeek provides no executable source-aligned command and asserts a physical analyzer requirement absent from Master. The literal amdxio command is potentially automatable but cannot run until vendor package, topology and receiver mapping are approved.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use the verified amdxio binary with explicitly supplied BDF sets and receiver=2/3 in two bounded runs, preserve separate CSVs and compare unique lane coverage to the approved topology; add analyzer steps only if engineering confirms them.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: lspci -PP discovery, amdxio -margin -pcie, ber=10, errcnt=5, receiver=2/3, comma-separated BDFs, 8x16=128 example and 15/10-minute estimates remain.

modernized_recommendation.status: CRITICAL SOURCE-CONFLICTED PACKAGE-GATED RETIMER MARGIN SEARCH
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Create two immutable run manifests binding each BDF/retimer port/lane to upstream or downstream receiver, command parameters and output CSV; verify expected-versus-observed lane sets and post-run link health independently.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds package trust, explicit topology/identity and bounded separate runs while refusing to import an unsupported physical-analyzer assumption or unstated margin thresholds.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A CSV with the expected total rows can still omit one lane and duplicate another, so unique lane identity must be checked. Row completeness also does not establish margin quality unless engineering supplies thresholds.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Vendor command semantics and retimer receiver numbering may be platform-specific; running against a wrong BDF/receiver can produce misleading data or link instability.

project_override_considerations: If vendor documentation mandates an external analyzer or fixture, this becomes MANUAL ONLY for that physical step; until the approved contract says so, the Master amdxio procedure supports package-gated execution rather than an assumed manual classification.
expected_evidence: Exact source row/variant/hash and engineering decision on instrument/classification/acceptance threshold
SUT/retimer/OAM firmware, amdxio checksum/version and PCIe topology/BDF/lane/link identities
Owner-approved receiver=2/3 manifests and exact commands
Separate upstream/downstream stdout/status/raw CSV hashes and unique lane-set/count comparison
Per-lane margin values retained without invented threshold, pre/post link/AER/log health and no-retry audit

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The authoritative Procedure specifies amdxio software execution with no physical analyzer, while DeepSeek and GPT V2 classify the essential work as external-analyzer/manual. In addition, the title describes a margin test but Criteria defines only CSV row completeness and no margin-quality threshold. Instrument requirement and acceptance scope require an approved resolution.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The conflict prevents execution/classification finality but not complete static review; it is queued for engineering while the library proceeds.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Functionality row 1973 Wistron-AMD SVM-00139-V004: confirm whether the Master amdxio command is the complete executable instrument or an external protocol analyzer/fixture is mandatory; provide exact retimer upstream/downstream BDF/lane and receiver=2/3 mapping, and decide whether PASS is only unique per-lane CSV completeness (source example 8x16=128) or also requires explicit margin thresholds.

review_improvement: Corrects an unsupported manual-only assumption, preserves every command parameter and exposes that row count measures coverage—not signal-quality acceptance.
independent_technical_reasoning: The Master describes software-initiated receiver margin search, so physical analyzer dependence cannot be inferred solely from the test name. Package-gated automation is feasible in principle because BDF discovery, command execution and CSV parsing are machine operations; the human-owned part is topology/receiver mapping and acceptance. Total row count is a weak oracle: duplicate lanes can mask omissions, and complete coverage says nothing about eye/margin quality. Therefore lane-set uniqueness and an explicit decision on thresholds are necessary without inventing values.
